specs_phase2.F2S: g(a) = 0.5*(1 + a/(1+|a|));  y = ((a*g(a))*b)*t  (elementwise; t runtime scalar)
specs_phase2.F3: out[r,0] = mean_d(x[r,:]);  var = mean_d((x - mean)^2);  out[r,1] = (var + eps)^(-1/2)
specs_phase2.F4: with P = D/4, x1 = x[:, 0:P], x2 = x[:, P:2P], xp = x[:, 2P:D]:  y1 = t*(x1*cos - x2*sin);  y2 = t*(x1*sin + x2*cos);  y = [y1, y2, xp]
specs_phase2.F5: y[r] = sum_k (q[r,k] * sc[r, floor(k/G)]) * a[k]   (q int8 and a fp16 converted exactly)
specs_phase2.F6: g = 0.5*(1 + h/(1+|h|));  w = m*g;  y[r,d] = sum_l w[r,l]*x[r,l,d] / sum_l w[r,l]
specs_phase2.F7: y[r] = sum_v softmax(p[r])_v * (log softmax(p[r])_v - log softmax(q[r])_v)
specs_phase2.F8: d = pred - target;  g = d if |d| <= delta else delta*sign(d);  y = g*m / nvalid
